opis: The sunny forest from the reference picture. On the LEFT the BEAR stands facing a big tree trunk, his forehead against the bark and BOTH paws over his eyes, counting - we see his back and the side of his head. Behind his back the others hurry to hide: the small HEDGEHOG scurries on tiptoe towards a mossy tree STUMP on the right. In the middle of the clearing the BUNNY stands IN FRONT of a round green BUSH, in full view, his whole body seen, his eyes squeezed tightly SHUT and a big proud grin - he thinks nobody can see him. Funny and sunny, a game of hide-and-seek.
